summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement (424B5) filed by Alpine Income Property Trust, Inc. to update an existing shelf agreement for the sale of Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock under its at-the-market offering program. It adds two new sales agents (Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities) and reports prior sales of approximately $7.6M, leaving up to ~$27.4M available. There are no acquisition, divestiture, special committee, or structural change elements; this is a routine capital-markets update with no special-situation event.
